column1: # Georgian (ka) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context <TAB> English source <TAB> translation
#   context    usually empty. `preview` words sample text inside rendered previews (the Design
#              tab's style-set tiles), which must fit a small tile; it falls back to the plain entry.
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\ inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns,
#              and a trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Clean room: translated from the meaning of the English labels in this repository.
# No Microsoft Word or other product localisation was consulted or copied.
# Product, format and technology names (WordCraft, PDF, Markdown, MCP …) stay in Latin letters.
# Georgian has no sentence capitals; terminology follows one glossary shared by the Craft apps.
# Licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0, like WordCraft.
